title: Access control
pageDescription: Decide who can reach this site by IP or IP range. New rules start in log-only mode — watch for a few days before enforcing.
platformDescription: Platform-wide list applied to every site. Global rules override a site's own allow rules.
createDescription: Enter an IP or range (CIDR). Log-only by default.
editDescription: Changes take effect immediately, and reach every instance by the next list refresh at the latest.
deleteConfirm: Delete rule {{cidr}}? This IP will no longer be affected by it.

field.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this here? Without it nobody will dare delete it in six months.

info.cidr: A bare address is treated as a full-length prefix. Block IPv6 at /64 — a home connection gets a whole /64, so blocking one address blocks nothing.
info.action: Allow outranks block. Use it to exempt monitoring, callbacks and your own office egress.
info.mode: Log-only records hits without blocking, so you can see who a rule would actually hit. Switch to enforce once you are sure.
info.expiresAt: Empty means never. Always set an expiry on temporary measures, or in six months nobody will remember why it is still there.

status.title: Runtime status
status.description: What the checker is actually configured with. Start here when a rule seems not to apply.
status.alwaysAllowEmpty: Not configured — one overly broad rule will lock you out too
status.autoBan: Auto-ban: {{threshold}} failures within {{window}} min, banned for {{minutes}} min
status.exportSkipped: No export path configured; all checking stays in the app layer
